title: Websites not loading, DNS suspected
symptom: Websites will not open but Teams still works
user_description: Websites say they can't be found, but Teams and my email still work. Is the whole internet down?

options.why: Teams and email work, so the cable is carrying data. Replacing it would not help.
Unlikely to help if the problem affects names across the PC. Test the network first.
Disrupts everyone and is not justified by one PC's symptoms.

options.text: Ping a public IP address and then a website name; if the address works but the name fails, check the PC's DNS settings and flush the DNS cache
options.why: DNS turns names into addresses. If an address responds but a name does not, DNS is the problem, and checking the DNS settings and clearing the cache is the next step.

hints: If some things work and websites do not, what part of the process might be broken?
How can you test with an address and with a name?
What turns a website name into an address?
real_world_tip: The command 'ipconfig /flushdns' clears the local DNS cache. It is a quick, safe step.
